properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 9 at 11:00PM CDT until August 10 at 1:15AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
At 1100 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
that thunderstorms were moving out of the area and rain rates were
decreasing. Up to 3 inches of rain occurred between Lee Center and
Ashton due to earlier storms.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Rapid-onset flooding of creeks, streams, drainage ditches,
streets, underpasses, low-lying areas, and other poor
drainage areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Amboy, Franklin Grove, Paw Paw, Lee, Compton, Steward, West
Brooklyn and Lee Center.
properties.instruction:
A Flash Flood Warning means rapid-onset flooding is imminent or may
already be occurring. Persons along creeks, drainage ditches, and
other waterways should take immediate precautions to protect life and
property.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 9 at 11:10PM CDT until August 10 at 12:45AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
SMWLOT

The National Weather Service in Chicago has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...

Nearshore Waters from Winthrop Harbor to Northerly Island...
Open Waters from Winthrop Harbor to Michigan City out to Mid
Lake...

* Until 1245 AM CDT.

* At 1110 PM CDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 12 nm west of Pleasant Prairie to 6 nm south of
Waukegan Harbor to near Ohare Airport, moving northeast at 30
knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Winthrop Harbor, Montrose Harbor, Waukegan Harbor, and Wilmette
Harbor.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 10:44PM MDT until August 9 at 11:00PM MDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
At 1043 PM MDT/1143 PM CDT/, severe thunderstorms were located along
a line extending from 7 miles north of Benkelman to 6 miles north of
Bird City to 5 miles southwest of St. Francis, moving southeast at 50
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

These severe storms will be near...
Bird City around 1150 PM CDT.

Other locations impacted by these severe thunderstorms include
Wheeler, Parks, and Max.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 9 at 8:43PM MST until August 10 at 12:45AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
FFWPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Maricopa County in south central Arizona...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 1245 AM MST.

* At 843 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
1 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen. Significant runoff into Vekol
Wash is expected or ongoing. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Freeman.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Vekol Wash, Kohatk Wash, Kaka Wash and Waterman Wash.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 11:36PM CDT until August 10 at 12:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
At 1136 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Palatine,
moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Arlington Heights, Palatine, Des Plaines, Mount Prospect, Glenview,
Buffalo Grove, Wheeling, Park Ridge, Elk Grove Village, Mundelein,
Niles, Vernon Hills, Lake Zurich, Barrington, Rolling Meadows,
Prospect Heights, Long Grove, Hawthorn Woods, Inverness,
Lincolnshire, Kildeer, Forest Lake, Deer Park, and Indian Creek.
properties.instruction:
A tornado watch remains in effect for the warned area. Tornadoes can
develop quickly from severe thunderstorms. Although a tornado is not
immediately likely, if one is spotted act quickly and move to a place
of safety inside a sturdy structure, such as a basement or small
interior room.

For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 11:35PM CDT until August 10 at 12:45AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
SVRLOT

The National Weather Service in Chicago has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Livingston County in central Illinois...
Southeastern La Salle County in north central Illinois...
Southern Grundy County in northeastern Illinois...

Remain alert for a possible tornado! Tornadoes can develop quickly
from severe thunderstorms. If you spot a tornado go at once into the
basement or small central room in a sturdy structure.

For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 9:41PM MST until August 9 at 10:30PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
SVRPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Maricopa County in south central Arizona...

* Until 1030 PM MST.

* At 940 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located over Buckeye,
moving west at 25 mph.

properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

This is a DANGEROUS SITUATION. This storm is producing widespread
wind damage across the West Valley. SEEK SHELTER NOW inside a sturdy
structure and stay away from windows!

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued August 9 at 11:45PM CDT until August 10 at 12:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
At 1145 PM CDT, a confirmed tornado was located near Grand Ridge, or
7 miles northeast of Streator, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Damaging tornado.

SOURCE...Radar confirmed tornado.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree damage is
likely.

Locations impacted include...
Ransom.
properties.instruction:
To repeat, a tornado is on the ground. TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a
basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy
building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in
a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect
yourself from flying debris.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 9 at 9:46PM CDT until August 10 at 12:45AM CDT by NWS Huntsville AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Madison County in north central Alabama...

* WHEN...Until 1245 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 942 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges measured 2
to 3" of rainfall in about half an hour earlier this evening,
with rainfall totals between 3-4" estimated in portions of
Northern and Western Huntsville. Local creeks in the city rose
several feet in an hour as a result. Indian Creek at Madison also
rose 4 feet during this time, and it continues to slowly rise.
Indian Creek should crest between 7 and 8 feet around or after
midnight, and slowly fall through sunrise.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Huntsville, Madison, Redstone Arsenal, Triana, Marshall Space
Flight Center, University Of Alabama In Huntsville, Huntsville
International Airport and Alabama A And M University.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
